title: SABMiller plc - proposed acquisition of Foster's Group Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: On 17 August 2011, SABMiller announced its intention to acquire all of the issued shares in Foster's Group Limited by way of a formal off-market takeover bid.
body_sections.Market definition: The proposed acquisition was considered in the context of a national market for the supply of bulk and packaged beer.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in any market. Factors informing this conclusion included: - the limited increase in market concentration that would occur as a result of the proposed acquisition; - the existence of competitors that will continue to constrain the merged firm, including parallel imports of beer products into Australia; and - the existence of alternative suppliers of control brand beers to the national supermarkets.
